اهتديتن (form VIII)
# اِهْتَدَيْتُنَّ (ihtadaytunna) /ih.ta.daj.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِهْتَدَى (ihtadā)
# اُهْتُدِيتُنَّ (uhtudītunna) /uh.tu.diː.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِهْتَدَى (ihtadā)
